summary: A Yes vote enacts a one-half percent transactions and use (sales) tax throughout the county, including its cities, for five years, with revenue going to the County General Fund for general government purposes.

tax.text: A Yes vote increases the sales tax by one-half percent for five years.
tax.quote: A “yes” vote on Measure “E” is a vote to approve a half-cent sales tax increase in the unincorporated area of the County and the incorporated cities for five years.

tax.text: A No vote keeps the sales tax rate at its current level.
